strings.en:
- Brought down a large beast early this morning. Tall and long, it ran on two legs and used its heavy tail as a counterbalance for its heavy head. From the teeth and the hide, it seemed to be an older specimen. This was another new one, so once we finish cleaning it, we'll preserve the remains to be studied.  
  
- Spotted the tracks of another, footprints much wider and flatter. We will try to pick up the trail before dusk, and we will continue the search tomorrow if needed.  
  
- Spotted a different kind of tracks by the stream today. Heavy and bipedal, likely an Inquest golem. They hadn't accounted for ground pressure, and it nearly sank into the mud. Fools have no idea what they're doing on terrain like this.
